description: M37A adaptive music track manifest — 30 base tracks (12 world ambient + 8 faction theme + 5 storyteller theme + 5 boss theme) × 4 variants (calm / buildup / climax / debrief) = 120 music files. Targets MusicGen-melody primary + Stable Audio Open fallback. Each track ships with per-faction LoRA hint, cross-fade curve, intensity thresholds. World ids align with DR-039 12-world catalog (M43 / M44). Faction ids align with game/content/factions/factions_full.json (8 launch factions). Storyteller ids align with M25 (5 directors: Cassandra / Phoebe / Randy / Ironman / Sandbox). Boss ids align with M45 (5 endgame bosses). Cross-fade engine cf-audio::adaptive_music selects {track, variant} per scenario state and intensity in [0.0, 1.0].

variant_schema.calm: ambient bed; sparse rhythm; minimal lead; sustains scenario but does not demand attention
variant_schema.buildup: tension rises; pulsing low end + rhythmic underlay added; lead motif begins; signals incoming threat
variant_schema.climax: full arrangement; drums + bass + lead + harmonic tension peak; combat / boss-phase active
variant_schema.debrief: reflective; sparse percussion + sustained pad + melodic recap; post-encounter wind-down

adaptive_engine_notes.selection_logic: cf-audio::adaptive_music selects {track, variant} per tick. Track selection priority: boss_arena > faction_engagement > world_default. Variant selection: intensity in [0.0,0.3]=calm; [0.3,0.6]=buildup; [0.6,0.9]=climax; [0.9,1.0]=climax-sustain; post-encounter=debrief.
adaptive_engine_notes.per_faction_lora_training: tools/audio_pipeline/music_composition/per_faction_lora_train.py reads 5+ reference seeds per faction; trains MusicGen LoRA; LoRA pinned per-track via lora_target field.
adaptive_engine_notes.stinger_routing: stinger SFX (alert / breakthrough / ally_lost / discovery / anomaly) route through ui_sfx bus, NOT music bus; they DUCK music -6 dB then restore over 500ms per voice priority rule

default.musicgen_prompt: Corefall intro slideshow cinematic theme, slow orchestral build, sweeping strings in D minor, distant brass swells, sparse piano motif, muted percussion entering at 30s, building to a hopeful brass-and-strings crescendo at 60s, modeled on Cortex Command's intro theme aesthetic — somber-yet-resolute, ending on a forward-looking note as the player's dropship descends to an untapped world, 75 seconds total, 72 BPM
